reason: I already have a provider with my shop name approved and credits left over, and 70 characters for one Sinhala credit is the same everywhere, so nothing here is a clear reason to switch right before 12.12. I might make the free account and send the 10 test SMS, but I won't move my list in my busiest month.
objection: Moving my customer list and getting my sender name approved again during a sale rush. If something goes wrong on 12.12 I lose the sale, and my current provider already works.
would_change_my_mind: A per-SMS price clearly below what I pay now at my usual top-up size, shown side by side, plus the free test messages actually arriving under my shop name the same day.
